These are modern, safe practices aligned with current Python packaging standards. The `prepare()` function performs a clean of the source directory, which helps ensure a reproducible build. The `check()` function runs tests using `pytest`, which is a legitimate quality assurance step.

There are no suspicious network operations, obfuscated commands, or file system manipulations outside the build environment. All operations are confined to the source and package directories, and no data exfiltration or external code execution is present. The package only installs its own files and a license, with no system-wide modifications or unexpected behaviors.
</details>
